'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Brian Fred LS We'll Handle This (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Fred]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This (V) / Duel Of The Fates (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
